purpose: Add strict walk-forward Structural Risk race context to the MARKET / MARKET+SEVEN_KING / MARKET+OUTSIDER router without changing rankings or the correction engines.

structural_risk_policy.reconstruction: runner-local from annual snapshots and the same horse/market rows used by L2

router_comparison.2023: Base Router only for routing because no pre-2023 OOS Structural Risk router-label history exists; Structural Risk scores are still generated leak-free for later training.
router_comparison.2024: BASE_SAME_HISTORY vs STRUCT_RISK using 2023 OOS history only.
router_comparison.2025: BASE_SAME_HISTORY vs STRUCT_RISK using 2023-2024 OOS history only.
router_comparison.reason: Measure incremental Structural Risk value without confounding by different router training years.

success_gate.primary: POOLED_2024_2025 Structural-Risk router has lower mean race logloss delta than same-history Base Router.
success_gate.strong: Bootstrap 95% CI of Structural-Risk minus Base Router is entirely below zero.
success_gate.stretch: Structural-Risk router beats fixed MARKET+OUTSIDER on 2024-2025.
